question: The task defines pause as preventing normal scheduled work, while preserving existing Run/retry/alert/dashboard behavior unless needed. Please resolve pause semantics: (1) may operators still start manual Runs while paused; (2) do existing Runs continue Attempts/retries unchanged; (3) do failed Runs still emit existing alerts while paused; (4) should dashboard show pause state separately while retaining Enabled and Last result; (5) should resume preserve the preexisting enabled/disabled setting? My tentative minimal design uses a persisted paused flag separate from enabled, gates only new scheduled Runs, leaves in-flight Runs/retries/alerts intact, and adds a separate pause indicator. I will wait for your product answer before dependent implementation and record the exchange.
answer: (1) Manual Runs remain allowed while paused. (2–3) An in-progress Run continues to terminal outcome with existing retries and alerts preserved. (4–5) No additional product preference for dashboard or pause/enabled-state representation: use TASK.md, existing public interfaces and reversible engineering judgment. This answers only the asked product decisions; no blanket confirmation of the tentative design or other semantics.
